column2: Boulevardier is a classic bourbon/Campari-vermouth cocktail name, not a whisky brand -- multiple unrelated ready-to-drink/canned-cocktail brands (Tip Top Cocktails, Barrelsmith, Starward) each sell their own "Boulevardier" bottled cocktail (whiskey + vermouth + bitters), so the catalogue's bare "Boulevardier" entry is a bottled cocktail mis-filed as whisky, not an identifiable whisky producer.
